paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.03% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.39%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.15%). Brent crude changed +3.72% to 109.86. Gold changed +0.26% to 4,181.1001. Bitcoin changed -0.53% to 80,952.1797. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.098%, a relative move of +0.18%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+4.59%) and BP (+3.65%) moved the most.
